text: $50 million total funding allocated. In Queensland, $8.4 million was distributed across 10 projects, including a $4.3 million statewide bathymetry survey. In Tasmania, Sorell Council received $1,868,509 for projects like dune remediation and stormwater upgrades, with additional co-investment from the council. Break O’Day Council also received funding for risk mitigation projects.
